Select molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles for all compounds in document CHEMBL4257575. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, and optionally to compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical_smiles. Filter by doc_chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4257575'. Order the results by molecule_chembl_id.
